name: Guide to Jailbreaking Frontier LLM Models

mentions.name: Guide to Jailbreaking Frontier LLM Models
mentions.description: A step-by-step guide to jailbreaking frontier LLM models that the author has been working on from time to time. It covers techniques such as tricking the model or classifier with noise and using lists of regex replacements to work around guardrails, and recommends starting with Opus 4.7 because of its strong system-prompt following in simulated environments.
mentions.source_excerpt: Here to ask if anyone would be interested in a step by step guide on jailbreaking frontier LLM models, something I've been working on from time to time and never felt the need to share since it's pretty boring considering the fact that you're just tricking the model / classifier with noise or/and having a list of regex of replacements to work around guardrails.
